top_signals.title: Everyone Is Chasing Scale: Petillo-Décossard
top_signals.summary: Kimberly Petillo-Décossard, global co-head of M&A White & Case, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the current state of dealmaking, market volatility, and how the federal regulatory environment affects the flow of deals. (Source: Bloomberg)
